description: Mohamed Mustapah Faiz v. Hon. Attorney General Mohamed Mustapah Faiz v. Hon. Attorney General View More before Hon. D.S.C. Lecamwasam, J.
parties: Mohamed Mustapah Faiz v. Hon. Attorney General Mohamed Mustapah Faiz v. Hon. Attorney General View More
keywords: The Appellant, a school teacher convicted of cruelty to a child under Section 308A of the Penal Code, appealed against the sentence. Held - considered assault to be a spontaneous act of excessive discipline without premeditation, malice or prior similar conduct; therefore, sentence reduced with fine to be treated as State costs.
legistation: Section 331 of the Code of Criminal Procedure Act No. 15 of 1979
